pages.text: Right-click the Big Book in hand or open it at a writing desk. It holds up to 256 pages with 44 lines per page. Select a line to change its format, color, or size. Use the arrows to move between pages.
Wrap a Book and Quill in paper to make a blank Big Book.

pages.title: Chapters and Signing
pages.text: Set up to eight chapter tabs to jump to their assigned pages. Save while drafting. Once you sign with a title, the pages and chapter labels become permanent. Readers can keep a bookmark.
